title: Bible Story: The chariot of fire
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 1 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child retells Elijah and the chariot of fire (2 Kings 2:1, 11-12) and lists ways to have a good relationship with God.

floor.question: Say a short prayer before eating.
floor.answer: Thank you God for this food. Amen

representations: picture of the chariot of fire

board.do: Draw a chariot with horses of fire.
Wait for the child to say up to heaven.
Write three ways to please God.

misconceptions.ask: How did Elijah leave the earth?
What came between Elijah and Elisha?
misconceptions.repair: Show a picture of a chariot pulled by horses.

misconceptions.ask: Name a way to have a good relationship with God.
misconceptions.repair: List: pray, read the Bible, obey, go to Sunday school.

checks.question: How did Elijah go to heaven?
checks.answer: In a whirlwind (with a chariot of fire)
